**STEP 1 - Scene:** A multi-component airline-style tray meal (roast chicken, lasagne, noodles, vegetables, fruit, potatoes, water). Photographed from the front at about 40°, with a colour checker card and a label (3091) in frame.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The central plate is about 22 cm across, so its area is about 380 cm². The lasagne plate is about 18 cm (254 cm²), the noodle plate about 17 cm (227 cm²), the vegetable bowl about 13.5 cm (143 cm²), and the fruit dish about 8 cm (50 cm²).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Roast chicken (breast and drumstick), roast potatoes, lasagne, mixed vegetables (carrot, broccoli, sweetcorn), fruit (strawberries and melon), stir-fried noodles. The water glass and brown bottle are not food and are excluded.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Chicken about 22% of the central plate (~84 cm²). Potatoes about 10% (~38 cm²). Lasagne about 60% of its plate (~150 cm²). Vegetables about 80% of the bowl (~115 cm²). Fruit about 80% of the small dish (~40 cm²). Noodles about 75% of their plate (~170 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Chicken 84 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 168 ml. Potatoes 38 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 95 ml. Lasagne piece ≈ 150 g, so about 165 ml. Vegetables 115 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 286 ml. Fruit 40 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 80 ml. Noodles 170 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 255 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Chicken 168 × 0.95 ≈ 160 g. Potatoes 95 × 0.9 ≈ 85 g. Lasagne ≈ 150 g. Vegetables 286 × 0.6 ≈ 170 g. Fruit 80 × 0.6 ≈ 48 g. Noodles 255 × 0.8 ≈ 180 g (rounded from ~204 g to be conservative on the thin, loosely piled noodles).

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Chicken 160 g × 170 kcal/100 g ≈ 272 kcal. Potatoes 85 g × 130 ≈ 110 kcal. Lasagne 150 g × 150 ≈ 225 kcal. Vegetables 170 g × 45 ≈ 77 kcal. Fruit 48 g × 40 ≈ 19 kcal. Noodles 180 g × 150 ≈ 270 kcal. Total ≈ 973 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 790 g across six components, with the largest plate about half covered, is plausible for a full airline tray meal. Total energy of roughly 970 kcal fits that scale. The estimate is uncertain by perhaps ±25%.
